review_candidates.title: Senior Architect Engineer
review_candidates.location: Qesm El Sheikh Zaid, Al Jizah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: About Us: Cyber Shield delivers fortified cybersecurity and intelligent IT solutions designed to protect and optimize Egypt’s expanding digital landscape. The company focuses on enabling organizations to operate with trust, resilience, and confidence by combining strong security practices with smart infrastructure design. Cyber Shield partners with businesses across Egypt to secure critical systems, streamline operations, and support sustainable growth. Team members contribute to building secure digital environments that help clients stay ahead of evolving threats while maintaining operational efficiency. Working Conditions: Full-Time , On-Site Role Location: Sheikh Zayed City Role Description The Senior Architectural Engineer will lead the design, planning, and implementation of complex construction and infrastructure projects that support Cyber Shield’s secure IT facilities and operational environments. This full-time, on-site role based in El shiekh zayed city involves developing architectural concepts, preparing detailed drawings and specifications, and coordinating with civil engineering and construction teams to ensure projects meet safety, regulatory, and performance standards. The Senior Architectural Engineer will oversee project timelines and budgets, manage stakeholder expectations, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate physical infrastructure with technical and security requirements. Daily responsibilities include reviewing design proposals, monitoring construction progress, resolving technical issues, and driving continuous improvement in design quality and project delivery. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Architecture skills, including concept development, detailed design, and familiarity with relevant codes and standards. Candidates should possess Civil Engineering and Construction skills to ensure structural integrity, compliance, and practical implementation of designs. Candidates should possess Project Management skills, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination. Candidates should possess Teamwork and cross-functional collaboration skills to work effectively with engineering, construction, and IT/security teams. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a closely related field; advanced degree or professional certifications (e.g., PMP, PE) are beneficial. Proven experience in leading medium to large-scale infrastructure or building projects, ideally within technology, industrial, or secure facilities environments. Proficiency in architectural and engineering design tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, BIM software) and strong technical documentation skills. Working knowledge of local building regulations, safety standards, and sustainability principles; experience in secure or mission-critical facilities is a plus. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to make sound decisions under time and resource constraints. Wanna Join our Expanding Team ? Apply Now via Job post or send your CV to: k.hesham@cybershieldits.com

review_candidates.title: Software Project Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Qode Bites is a digital solutions partner focused on building high-quality, user-centric websites, applications, and platforms that help businesses grow and scale. The company collaborates with startups and established enterprises to turn ideas into reliable, scalable digital products. Qode Bites combines creativity with strong engineering practices, designing with empathy and building with precision while keeping end users at the center. The team delivers future-ready solutions, whether launching an e-commerce store, developing a mobile app, or supporting platforms that serve thousands of users. Role Description This is a full-time remote/hybrid role for a Software Project Manager. The Software Project Manager will lead end-to-end project delivery for web and mobile development initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams including developers, designers, and QA specialists. Responsibilities include defining project scope, managing timelines and budgets, facilitating requirements gathering, and translating business needs into actionable technical tasks. The role involves tracking progress, identifying risks, implementing mitigation plans, and ensuring clear communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. The Software Project Manager will also support continuous improvement by refining processes, tools, and workflows to enhance quality and efficiency. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Software Project Management and Project Management skills to plan, execute, and deliver digital projects effectively. Candidates should possess Software Development and Requirements Analysis skills to understand technical solutions and translate business needs into clear specifications. Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret data, assess risks, and make informed decisions that keep projects on track. Candidates should possess excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills to coordinate distributed teams and maintain transparent updates. Candidates should possess experience with Agile or similar methodologies, using project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana) to organize work. Candidates should possess a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Candidates should possess experience managing software or digital product projects; familiarity with web and mobile technologies is highly beneficial. Candidates should possess strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
